steps.title: Mission planner
steps.text: Here you plan the vehicle's work on the map: where it starts, which points it passes, which areas it covers and where it must not go. Let's walk through the screen.

steps.title: Mission and file
steps.text: The mission name. Next to it, the file it is saved in and a note when there are unsaved changes.

steps.title: Vehicle status
steps.text: Shows whether the connected vehicle carries this plan. When the vehicle has a different mission, tap the badge to open it.

steps.title: Files
steps.text: Start a new mission, open one from a file or save the current one. The save button is highlighted while there are unsaved changes.

steps.title: Vehicle
steps.text: Upload the mission to the vehicle or read the one it already carries. Both need a connected autopilot.

steps.title: More and close
steps.text: The menu holds Save as and export for QGroundControl (.plan) and Mission Planner (.waypoints). The cross closes the editor and asks about unsaved changes first.

steps.title: Tools
steps.text: Everything you put on the map starts here. Pick a tool, then tap the map. Tap the active tool again to put it away.

steps.title: Start point
steps.text: Where the mission begins. Until it is placed, this button and the Start point row on the right are highlighted.

steps.title: Waypoints
steps.text: Single points the vehicle passes in order. While the tool is active, every tap on the map adds the next point.

steps.title: Survey and corridor
steps.text: A survey covers an area with parallel passes, a corridor follows a line. You choose how to draw the shape, from a ready template or point by point, and the check mark button finishes it.

steps.title: Rally points and geofence
steps.text: Rally points are safe places to return to. The geofence sets zones the vehicle must stay inside or keep out of.

steps.title: Undo and view
steps.text: Undo and redo your edits, fit the whole mission on screen, zoom in and out.

steps.title: Map layer
steps.text: Tap to switch back to the previous map. Press and hold to pick one from the full list.

steps.title: Map
steps.text: Points and shapes are placed here. Tap an item to select it, drag its handles to edit, the plus sign inserts a vertex.

steps.title: Prompt
steps.text: This prompt always says what the map expects from you right now.

steps.title: Mission panel
steps.text: The whole mission as a list: plan settings, route, rally points, geofence and the summary.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: Cruise speed and what the vehicle does after the last point: return to the start point, return to launch, hold position or leave it to the autopilot.

steps.title: Start point status
steps.text: Shows whether the start point is placed. Tapping the row arms the Start point tool if it is missing, otherwise it selects the point on the map.

steps.title: Route
steps.text: Route items in the order the vehicle runs them. Tap a card to select it and open its settings. Drag a card or use its arrows to change the order.

steps.title: Summary
steps.text: Route length, time at cruise speed, the number of waypoints and how many mission items the autopilot receives out of its limit. Problems with the plan are listed here too.

steps.title: That's all
steps.text: Open this tour again any time with this button.
